entry.title: What Makes a Good Website? Lessons From the Edge
entry.summary: Over the past few years, I’ve had the privilege of working across fintech, blockchain, healthcare, and a variety of ambitious ventures through my consultancy work and Inflection Studio. Somewhere along the way, I started to notice a pattern. Projects that thrived weren’t always the ones with the biggest budgets or flashiest designs. They were the ones that got the fundamentals right. This post is an attempt to capture those lessons. Not as “best practices” in the abstract, but as principles I’ve seen play out in the wild. Consider this my working definition of what makes a good website. A good website doesn’t confuse you. The value proposition is clear from the first glance. You know what the business is about, who it’s for, and what to do next. Too many projects get caught up in aesthetic…
